pages.text: The $(item)Tank$() stores a single type of fluid in very large quantities. It locks to the first fluid inserted and connects to the $(l:network/network_interface)fluid network$() via a tube.

pages.title: Upgrades
pages.text: $(bold)Storage Upgrade$() — raises the tier and capacity by one step:$(br2)Wood → Copper → Iron → Gold → Diamond → Emerald → Netherite$(br2)The tank unlocks again once fully drained.

pages.title: Fluid Interaction
pages.text: $(bold)Right-click with a Bucket$() to fill or drain 1,000 mB.$(br)$(bold)Glass Bottle$() fills or drains 250 mB of water.$(br)$(bold)Honey Bottle$() fills or drains 250 mB of honey.$(br2)The tank UI includes input and output slots for fluid container items.$(br2)Enable $(thing)Void Excess$() in the settings panel to automatically discard overflow fluid.

pages.title: Other Upgrades
pages.text: $(bold)Puller Upgrade$() — pulls fluid from adjacent fluid handlers each tick; configurable per side.$(br2)$(bold)Magnet Upgrade$() — collects fluid container items (full buckets, bottles) that are dropped nearby.
